# Why can MiniMax H3 understand JSON BBOX? — Experiments with Qwen3-VL and Structured Canvas
## Training examples for returning BBOX in JSON also exist in the official repository.
```
Locate house in this image and output the bbox coordinates in JSON format.
```

```
{
  "bbox_2d": [135, 114, 1016, 672]
}
```

```
JSON object
+
bbox key
+
numerical coordinates
+
object identity
```

## The 0-1000 coordinate range also has a basis
```
bbox / 1000 * [img_w, img_h, img_w, img_h]
```

```
bbox = [80, 500, 410, 900]
```

## From here on, a hypothesis: Inverse Grounding
```
{"bbox_2d":[...]}
```

```
object description
+
bbox
+
stable ID
+
scene description
        ↓
Qwen3-VL hidden representation
        ↓
H3 generation conditioning
        ↓
output composition
```

## Finally
```
2D grounding
relative coordinates
BBOX
spatial perception
JSON grounding
```
